Princeton Portfolio Strategies Group Llc increased its stake in Dollar General Corp New (DG) by 7.56% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Princeton Portfolio Strategies Group Llc bought 6,075 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.95% with the market. The institutional investor held 86,406 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.08 million, up from 80,331 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Princeton Portfolio Strategies Group Llc who had been investing in Dollar General Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $26.48 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.78% or $0.78 during the last trading session, reaching $98.95. About 689,518 shares traded.
